mira: Hey team — hitting a weird auth/retry thing in the ruby sampleapp after upgrading ruby-sdk to v0.8.2. Sample app sporadically 500s on /generate with 'token refresh failed' and it looks like no retry is attempted. Anyone seen this? @sam

sam: Hmm, thanks for the ping. Any logs or a repro? Is this the local sampleapp or the examples repo one?

mira: It's the examples repo one, running locally with docker-compose. Logs: ``
I, [2026-03-20T14:05:22.345Z] INFO -- : POST /v1/generate 500
E, [2026-03-20T14:05:22.346Z] ERROR -- : TokenRefreshError: refresh returned 401
  from /usr/src/app/vendor/bundle/ruby/3.1.0/gems/ruby-sdk-0.8.2/lib/redwood/auth.rb:78:in `refresh'
``
Also using default client init: `client = Redwood::Client.new(token: ENV['RW_TOKEN'], auto_refresh: true)`

sam: We adjusted retry semantics recently to avoid retrying on 401s from refresh flows (risk of infinite loops), but sampleapp should definitely handle TokenRefreshError gracefully. Can you paste a minimal repro or a gist?

jen: quick note — there was a similar report filed earlier this month in examples (issue #412) about sampleapps not surfacing refresh failures cleanly. Might be the same class of problem.

ci-bot: Created issue examples/412 for "ruby sampleapp: TokenRefreshError causes 500 without retry" — https://git.company/examples/issues/412

sam: ok, short term we can catch TokenRefreshError in the sampleapp wrapper and do a bounded retry with backoff. Long term we should expose an explicit opt-in flag in the SDK so apps don't need to add their own hacks. Proposed rescue snippet: ``
begin
  resp = client.generate(prompt: prompt)
rescue Redwood::TokenRefreshError => e
  sleep 0.5
  client.refresh!
  retry
end
``

oliver: Idea: make it opt-in `retry_on_refresh: {max_attempts: 2, base_backoff: 0.5}` in client config so defaults remain safe. If we add this, update changelog + upgrade guide.

sam: Agree — opt-in safer. I'll open a tiny SDK PR for 0.8.3 to add `:retry_on_refresh` and a unit test covering a simulated 401 during refresh. Assigning reviewers.

mira: I can open the sampleapp PR to add the rescue for now and reference the SDK PR. I have a 3-line change ready.

sam: :thumbsup: please do and link both PRs. If CI flakes on the example tests, ping me and I'll rerun.

ci-bot: PR created: examples#789 — "ruby: handle TokenRefreshError in sampleapp" (linked to sdk#102)

oliver: LGTM in principle, please include a small test and a changelog entry in the SDK PR. Also add an upgrade note to examples/README.

mira: Will do, thanks all!"
